acceptanceCriteria.criterion: All live launch inputs (merchant, region, domain, real price, channel entry and support/retention policies) are confirmed with traceable sources; any UNKNOWN blocks the affected real sale or public claim.
All five direct dependencies and required transitive payment interfaces are accepted before behavior execution; scripts/evidence provenance are explicit.

No immediate invalidation of a TTL-valid signed URL or remote erasure of downloaded/local decrypted copies is claimed.
G4 purchase, signature, idempotency, reconciliation, refund/revoke, expiry/grace, restore/account mapping, cross-channel and forged-Pro cases have owner evidence.
Capacity, deletion, export, recovery, privacy and feature copy match accepted behavior; all applicable S01-S27 subscenarios are closed or keep the affected release scope off.
Support, restore, delete, backup and retention promises identify what is actually confirmed; unresolved policies block paid claims.
Synthetic privacy canaries do not appear in telemetry/crash/structured-error/support outputs; failure/cancel/offline/permission states are truthful.
Formal price and capacity claims are supported by approved, dated cost evidence covering all 07 §5 categories; candidate limits remain labeled candidates until decided.
